purpose: Correct one predeclared Sentinel-1 GRD annotation-label requirement after preserving the exact failed real run.

authoritative_findings.finding: The official product specification defines pixelValueType as Complex or Detected and the imageInformation pixelValue field as Detected or Complex.
The official GRD processing description states that GRD products are detected and their pixel values represent detected amplitude.

proposed_exact_change.physical_interpretation_note: For these GRD products, the schema label is Detected and the physical pixel interpretation is detected amplitude.
proposed_exact_change.implementation_change: Read the expected pixelValue from the amended contract instead of hard-coding AMPLITUDE in portable validation.
unchanged_checks: three exact pre-event source identities and receipt and manifest hashes
nine required SAFE member roles per source and selected-member rehashing
DTD and entity refusal and exact mission, GRD, IW, polarization, acquisition, absolute-orbit, and direction checks
finite strictly increasing embedded orbit vectors bracketing acquisition
ArcGIS TIFF, one-band U16, dimension, and VV/VH consistency checks
complete before and after external attempt inventories
network, authentication, credential, mutation, pixel-decoding, and derived-raster prohibitions

bounded_actions_if_approved: preserve the current contract, real BLOCK receipt, reconciliation, prepublication attempts, commits, and CI runs unchanged
create a new versioned contract whose only observed-data semantic correction is pixelValue Detected instead of AMPLITUDE and whose source citations bind this proposal
update the portable validator to compare pixelValue with the new contract value and add focused tests for Detected acceptance and AMPLITUDE refusal
run synthetic ArcGIS validation only to a new identity and preserve every attempt
publish the amended gate and require successful public CI for its exact commit
after that CI succeeds, run one read-only inspection of the same three exact materialized sources to a new no-replace real-002 receipt
reconcile the exact pass or block without retry, threshold changes, or downstream release
stop_rules: Stop if the amended implementation changes any requirement outside the exact pixelValue label and contract-driven comparison.
Stop if a bound source, receipt, manifest, file, or publication identity differs.
Stop and preserve the result if synthetic or real validation blocks or any external file changes.
Do not retry real-002 under the approved amendment.

decision_semantics.approval_effect: authorizes only the bounded amendment implementation, validation, publication, one real-002 read-only inspection, and exact reconciliation
decision_semantics.known_observation_contamination: The correction is post-observation and expected to clear the already observed label mismatch; it is not a blind or independent validation.
